_doc: T17 BLIND held-out set (Review #7 N1). Written and frozen BEFORE the model was run on it; never used to fit TAU. Labels describe what a human sees in each image (contact-sheet inspection, no model output). 'present' items each match exactly one image in this folder; 'absent' items describe nothing in the blind images, in the 13 tau-fit search subjects, or in the 3 football photos. Corpus = blind images (1 frame each) + 13 search subjects x 5 variants + 3 football photos x 5 variants. All images are CC0 (Wikimedia Commons, category CC-Zero).
